script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [setup] Start gateway-rs, service-go and service-cs from the built tree and check each listens on its hardcoded port; logs exit code and 2 KB of stderr of every process. A failure here is FAIL webdeps_setup, not a finding.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H1] Gateway alone, no backends: GET every backend route; FAIL H1 if the process exits, aborts or prints 'panicked'. Verdict H1:pass / H1:fail.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H1] Fake C backend on the service-go then the service-cs address replying empty body, truncated JSON, random bytes and a reset after accept; FAIL H1 if the gateway dies or panics. Verdict H1:pass / H1:fail.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H2] service-go with a fake peer on its upstream that accepts and never replies; FAIL H2 if no response within 30 s. Verdict H2:pass / H2:fail.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H2] service-cs, then service-go, with the peer refusing, answering HTTP 500 and sending garbage; FAIL H2 if a 200/OK has no error indication. Verdict H2:pass / H2:fail.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H3] tapi_netexpose over the three running services; FAIL H3 on 0.0.0.0, ::, a non-loopback address or a port outside the hardcoded set. Findings go to the tapi_cybersec_report. Verdict H3:pass / H3:fail.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H3] tapi_egress with an allow-list of the hardcoded loopback endpoints, one request through each service; FAIL H3 on any other destination. Verdict H3:pass / H3:fail.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H1, informational] tapi_binscan of the gateway binary appended to the report; never fails.
